module: Compliance heat map (slope and corner radius) of the Hero Road Editor. compute() scores each station of the group's centerline from 0 (compliant) to 1 (total violation) according to the chosen road class (group.roadClass) and stores the result in group.heatGrade / group.heatRadius. draw() paints a blue-to-red colored ribbon on the roadway of the selected road.
notes: Road classes (minRadiusM / maxGradePct): highway 200 m / 6 %, rural 90 m / 8 %, urban 40 m / 12 %, mountain 15 m / 15 %, rally 8 m / 20 %. Default class: rural if group.roadClass is unknown.

Radius score: 0 above 2*minR, linear ramp from 2*minR to minR, 1 below minR. It is weighted by the deflection of the nearest node (0 below 1 degree, 1 from 5 degrees, smoothing in between) to ignore mere tangent kinks.
Slope score: 0 up to the class limit, 1 from 2 times the limit.
Curvature and slope are smoothed twice over a half-window of 4 m (smoothByDistance). The exact curvature comes from group.divCurv (engineered mode, clothoids), otherwise from a finite difference.
compute() does nothing if group.divPoints has fewer than 3 points (emptied tables); draw() requires heatGrade, heatRadius, divWidths and binormals.
The ribbon is raised by 0.10 m and drawn in both winding directions to be visible from all angles.

classes.desc: Road classes keyed by id ('highway', 'rural', 'urban', 'mountain', 'rally'), each with label, minRadiusM (m), maxGradePct (%) and desc.

classOrder.desc: Display order of the classes: highway, rural, urban, mountain, rally.

compute.desc: Fills group.heatGrade[i] and group.heatRadius[i] (0 compliant to 1 total violation) for each station of group.divPoints. To be called when the geometry changes or every display frame.

group.desc: Hero Road group (divPoints, divCurv, divWidths, nodes, discMap, roadClass).

draw.desc: Draws the solid violation ribbon for the selected road: two half-panels per segment (left edge to crown, crown to right edge), colored by util.getHueBasedColour255 (alpha 210) according to the metric.

metric.desc: 'grade' or 'radius'; any other value is treated as 'grade'.
